resources.string: Backups include toolbox settings and internal app data, lyrics and artwork. Executables, audio files, system permissions and running tasks are excluded. Music folder access may need to be granted again.

Music, Messenger and Colour Vision are now internal apps with separate downloads, installation and updates.

Course notifications use a system countdown. Messenger sessions continue across navigation, Home and screen lock.

Full backups include internal app data and accept older toolbox configurations. A same-device music migration tool links the original folder while preserving playlists, lyrics, artwork and track details.

Delete local settings, data and private supporting files for %1$s? This cannot be undone. Audio and lyrics in the music folder are not deleted, and the app remains installed. Export any data you want to keep first.
Uninstalling removes executable code only. Delete retained Music, Messenger or Color Vision data here. Full backups also include retained data for uninstalled apps.
